description: Requirement extraction and clarification policy; a question batch limit never discards unresolved blockers.

blocking_questions.condition: A material correctness, acceptance, scope, authority, or bounded-execution choice remains unresolved after inspecting available evidence.
examples: ambiguous benchmark identity with incompatible interfaces
until-converged execution without a finite existing budget

optional_preferences.condition: A preference would improve ranking but is not necessary for correct authorized progress.
optional_preferences.action: Record an in-scope default and continue; low estimate confidence is not an approval gate.
examples: unspecified ranking among existing resource objectives

extractable_fields.latency_ns_max: Numeric hard latency limit with units; otherwise null.
extractable_fields.ii_ns_max: Numeric hard transaction interval bound; do not confuse throughput with latency.
extractable_fields.resource_limits: Resolve LUT/FF/DSP/URAM counts and BRAM_18K versus BRAM_36K units from evidence.
extractable_fields.power_w_max: Use an explicit measured-power requirement; DSP count is not a power measurement.
extractable_fields.priority: Only the relevant configured objectives; do not force an unrelated fixed list.

unit_conversion.frequency_to_period: 1000 / frequency_mhz; do not round into a slower period.

clock_selection: Filter existing benchmark candidates by the actual hard frequency requirement. No invented universal candidates or implicit example-device clock.
